@doom369 thanks will have a look. I have kind of the feeling that it may be related to:
https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/ba381f1a27c3251fa13725f09dd0cb771326f113

@doom369 tried to reproduce with a unit test but no luck :( Could you try to write a small unit test for it ? Maybe have a look at `DefaultChannelPipelineTest` and add something in there which shows the problem with netty only ?
@doom369 awesome! I know where the problem is and work on a fix. For a workaround just call `ctx.read()` or `channel.read()` in the ChannelFuture that is added to `eventLoop.register`.
@doom369 please check https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/4814. This fixes the problem here.

@normanmaurer Above example works. Most of tests fine also. But still there are few that doesn't work. I'm using tcp, http, websockets and SSL versions of them. And all of them has pipelines with reregister logic. Http reregister tests not work anymore. I'll try to make a reproducer for HTTP, but a bit later. Maybe tomorrow.
